mission.title: Sneaky
mission.description: Stop the Merovingian's attempt to break into the Oligarchs' virtual space and find out how he means to get in.

phase.briefing: Operative, intelligence indicates that the Merovingian has located a virtual space utilized by Helian and Tesarova, and is preparing to obtain access to it. It is not in our interests that the Oligarchs should be aggravated by such machinations within the simulation. You are required to put a stop to this Exile plot.

enter.say:
I heard that the Merv's been trying everything he can come up with to obtain Oligarch override programs for himself; they say he tried hitting on Tesarova, but that didn't quite work for him, so now he's just gonna try some breaking and entering.
I'm reading rogue programs in there, so watch it.

done.say: Whew. Let's see about that computer they were guarding.
Good. If Gray pointed us to the right spot, this might actually go somewhere...

phase.briefing: The Merovingian's intended means of infiltrating the Oligarch construct area is unknown, operative. That is something you must determine, if possible.

enter.say: Not picking anything up so far.

done.say: Good, that took care of the interference.

objective.text: Get the Data from the Computer

done.say: Hmm...Overlapping spatial indicators...I think I know what this is, but it'll need Machine help to parse it.

near.say:
Getting some kind of interference here. But I don't see...
There!

mission.finish:
The information you recovered indicates access routes through "white hallway" systems. This is likely the Merovingian's means of entering the Oligarch area.
While incomplete, we estimate that the entry point is at a high altitude, in an area approximately corresponding to north Union Hill.
A white hallway system's interface is typically an otherwise ordinary-looking door. The door will lead to an area that is not physically linked to its surroundings.
